events.title: "Imagine" Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album "Imagine" was released 55 years ago this week in 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' is an album with a message that still resonates today. What's your favourite track from Lennon's masterpiece?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known globally as Sting, the legendary frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Greatest Hits
angles.copy: From The Police to his solo career, Sting has given us so many hits. Which one always gets you singing along?

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple introduced the first iPod, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Quarter of a century old today! Did you have one, and what was the first album you loaded onto it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the very first Bond film, "Dr. No," in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's enduring legacy. What's your top Bond theme tune of all time?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Defining Song
angles.copy: A true legend would have turned 86 today. John Lennon's impact on music and culture is undeniable. What's the one song that truly defines him for you?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Favourite Cleese Moment
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: "The White Album" Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as "The White Album," was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Standout
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58 today! A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their individual talents. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Ultimate Queen Anthem
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost Freddie Mercury, but his voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album "Rubber Soul" was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Favourite
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles pushed boundaries with this one. Which track from the album is still a firm favourite for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of musical icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Moving Song
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's the one song of his that always moves you?

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Favourite Persona/Song
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie's artistry knew no bounds. Which of his many personas or songs is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis's Dance Anthem
angles.copy: All hail the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. What's the one Elvis track that still makes you want to get up and dance?

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Iconic Page Riff
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped generations. What's the most iconic Led Zeppelin guitar moment for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer with the distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's Favourite Anthem
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! His career is packed with anthems. Which Rod hit holds a special place in your heart?

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness's Best Track
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs from Madness! The voice behind so many brilliant hits. What's your favourite Madness track to skank along to?
